name: Governed Policy Runtime
summary: Introduces deterministic, explainable and fail-closed policy evaluation over one authoritative versioned registry, enabling governance to scale across capabilities, AI agents, services and experiences without hardcoded rules.
changes: Policy Runtime 1.0 with bounded declarative conditions
Versioned Policy Registry 2.0 with priorities, effects, obligations and evidence requirements
Deterministic conflict resolution and fail-closed registry validation
Explainable verdicts with condition traces and winning policy
Policy events for evaluation, denial and manual review
test_focus: Existing website and workspaces remain functional
Unhealthy releases and unsafe mutations are denied
High-risk AI decisions route to explicit human review
